thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P10023 triggered — elevated 5xx rate observed for dedicated-pool-d42 (region: us-west-2). Affected customer: HavenBridge (enterprise). Links: https://pd.example/INCIDENTS/P10023 — please acknowledge.

Claire (oncall): Ack — I'm on it. Paging SREs and AMs.

Noah (sre): Investigating. Seeing ~18% 5xx on /v1/generate routed to d42. Error surface looks like gRPC upstream 503 from inference-runtime. Traces show increased memory pressure on GPU nodes at ~15:03 UTC.

Claire (oncall): Can we confirm which customers are on d42 besides HavenBridge? Need contact routing.

Ava (acct mgmt): HavenBridge is the only Tier-1 customer pinned to d-42. Primary contacts: Mara Ortega <mara@havenbridge.com>, CTO Elias Park <elias@havenbridge.com>. They are on-call until 18:00 PST. SLA: 99.9% p95 latency, dedicated throughput.

Lena (support): HavenBridge reported 5xx errors via support ticket #HB-4321 at 15:08. They've started routing around 15:00.

Noah (sre): Short term mitigation: 1) Disable new model rollout on d42; 2) Evacuate pods on the most memory-hot nodes; 3) Trigger autoscale to add spare nodes. Rolling steps now.

DevOps (eng): Starting rollback of model_variant=v2.1 -> v2.0 on d42. Command:```sh
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/dedicated-d42 --to-revision=REV_2
``` ETA ~12 min for rollout to stabilize.

Claire (oncall): Drafting customer-facing notification. Please review: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting inference for your dedicated cluster (d-42) which may cause failed requests and intermittent timeouts. Our engineering team has rolled back a recent model rollout and is adding capacity; we expect recovery within 30 minutes. We will update you as we have new information."

Ava (acct mgmt): Good. Add: "We understand impact to live user sessions and are prioritizing your traffic. If you need a direct update, call Elias or Mara — we've opened a bridge with them."

Lena (support): Add support ticket link and provide case number. Also include small repro guidance so their engineers can check: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"...","input":"..."}'` and attach request id when filing.

Noah (sre): Rollback started; pod restarts happening. Memory pressure metric dropping on two nodes. 5xx rate decreasing to ~6% on sample traffic. Continuing to monitor KV cache heat.

Statuspage Bot: Draft status: "Partial outage — Dedicated inference 5xx errors affecting a subset of customers in us-west-2 (HavenBridge). Engineers investigating; mitigation in progress. Updates every 15 minutes."

Claire (oncall): Approve statuspage draft. Ava, can you send the tailored notification to HavenBridge now (include support ticket and bridge link)?

Ava (acct mgmt): Sending now — DMing the CH notice and posting in their support thread. Template used: "We are actively investigating..." (as above) + ETA 30m. cc: @Elias @Mara. :email:

DevOps (eng): Autoscaler added 2 nodes as planned. Observability: p95 latency stable, error budget burn slowed. Keeping autoscale active until steady state.

Noah (sre): Confirmed ingress routing fallback enabled for low-priority customers only — HavenBridge remains on d42 (pinned) so no automatic failover. Considering temporary routing to warm spare if errors spike again.

Claire (oncall): Decision: keep HavenBridge on d42 (to preserve session affinity) but open a manual fallback plan if >10% 5xx for 5m. Notify @legal if we hit SLA threshold.

Lena (support): HavenBridge acknowledged receipt, asked for regular updates. They requested a short tailored impact blurb for their execs: "Some inference requests may fail or time out between 15:00–15:40 PST while we stabilize; no data exposure." Ava to send.

Ava (acct mgmt): Sent exec blurb and support link. They replied :thumbsup:.

Noah (sre): 5xx now steady at ~2.1%. Rollback appears successful. Leaving monitoring alerts open for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident P10023 auto-updated: status -> partial_degraded, responders -> Claire, Noah, DevOps, Ava.

Claire (oncall): Closing update for this thread — will post final statuspage and customer notify after 30m if stable. Good job team. :raised_hands:

Statuspage Bot: Update posted: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/PD-P10023 —"Service degraded — remediation in progress; rollback successful, monitoring."

Noah (sre): Marking incident for postmortem once we confirm root cause (OOM during model variant transition). Action items: add model rollout canary memory guard, improve autoscaler thresholds, document manual fallback for pinned customers.

Ava (acct mgmt): I'll send the post-incident customer communication template and schedule a 1:1 with HavenBridge tomorrow.

Claire (oncall): Thanks everyone. Ending thread.
